name: Birth Certificate
description: Issuance of official birth certificate registration for newborns and citizens born within the municipal boundaries.
required_documents: Parents' Government Photo ID Proof (e.g. Aadhaar/Passport)

form_schema.name: place_of_birth
form_schema.label: Place of Birth (Hospital/Home)
form_schema.placeholder: Name of hospital or residence address

name: Death Certificate
description: Official municipal registration and certification of death occurring within municipal jurisdiction.
required_documents: Hospital Death Summary / Medical Certification of Cause of Death

name: Marriage Registration
description: Official municipal certification and registration of solemnized marriages.
required_documents: Marriage Invitation Card or Religious Solemnization Certificate
Age Proof of Bride and Groom (Birth Certificate or Passport)
Joint Marriage Photograph & 3 Witnesses' ID Proofs

name: Property Tax Services
description: New property tax assessment, reassessment, ownership name transfer, and title clearance requests.

form_schema.name: property_address
form_schema.label: Exact Property Location
form_schema.placeholder: Plot, Door No, Street, Ward, Zone

name: Trade License
description: Application for fresh municipal trade licenses or periodic annual renewals for business premises.
required_documents: Proof of Business Premises Ownership or Rental Agreement
Fire Safety NOC (for applicable commercial activities)

name: Water Connection
description: Apply for a new domestic or commercial municipal piped water connection or connection transfer.
required_documents: Ownership Proof of Property (Title deed or tax receipt)

name: Building Permission
description: Sanction of architectural building plans, construction permits, and structural alteration approvals.
required_documents: Title Deed and Land Non-Encumbrance Certificate
Site Layout Plan and Soil Test Report

form_schema.name: property_location
form_schema.label: Construction Location & Plot Details
form_schema.placeholder: Plot No, Survey No, Ward, Street

name: Sanitation Services
description: Special municipal sanitation, pest spraying, septic tank clearance, and public disinfectant drives.

form_schema.name: description
form_schema.label: Service Details & Requirements
form_schema.placeholder: Describe what sanitation service is needed (e.g. Septic tank emptying, fogging, drain desilting)

name: Streetlight Repair
description: Request maintenance, bulb replacement, or wiring repairs for municipal street lights.

form_schema.name: location
form_schema.label: Street Location & Pole Number
form_schema.placeholder: Street name, ward, nearest pole number

form_schema.name: description
form_schema.label: Problem Description
form_schema.placeholder: e.g. Lamp burnt out, pole leaning, wire loose

name: Drainage Services
description: Report severe blockage, overflowing stormwater drains, or request underground drainage inspection.

form_schema.name: location
form_schema.label: Drainage Location
form_schema.placeholder: Exact spot of drain blockage or overflow

form_schema.name: description
form_schema.label: Issue Description
form_schema.placeholder: Describe severity, stagnant water, overflow details

name: Waste Collection
description: Scheduled bulk waste pickup, commercial debris disposal, or horticulture waste removal requests.

form_schema.name: description
form_schema.label: Waste Description & Volume
form_schema.placeholder: Type of waste (bulk furniture, tree cuttings, construction debris) and approximate volume

name: Other Municipal Services
description: General civic administrative inquiries, tree trimming permissions, and non-categorized municipal requests.

form_schema.name: description
form_schema.label: Request Details
form_schema.placeholder: Explain your civic inquiry or municipal service request
